subject: Cloud Master projects shelf plan (operator-approved direction): build THREE real projects, retire the duplicate. Slot 1 = 'Build a Cloud Auditor' (new, replaces the cloud-openstack-iac-codify slot which duplicates the capstone LAB). Slot 2 = 'Survive the Drift' (cloud-openstack-iac-harden, already registered, unbuilt) -- run your applier twice and nothing changes, break a resource by hand and it reconciles. Slot 3 = 'Same Intent, Different Cloud' (cloud-openstack-iac-translate, already registered, unbuilt) -- port the manifest to a second provider's primitives with a dry-run adapter; needs no second cloud because the deliverable is the mapping. ONE DEPENDENCY FIX: harden's prerequisite currently points at cloud-openstack-iac-codify (the dup); it should point at the capstone LAB, where the student actually builds the applier. Each project needs a ~110K phased page, its own bc1 check ids beyond 25-28, and BOTH harnesses (walkthrough + adversarial).
